company.name: Beulr
company.one_liner: An app that attends your online meetings and classes for you.

facts.summary: Beulr loops a video of you in Zoom meetings and alerts you if your name is called, so you can step away.
highlights: Many users are students skipping online classes.
Some people think it encourages cheating.
Video-meeting companies could block it or build their own version.

real_deal.summary: No deal. The sharks worried about ethics and whether the business would last.

outcome.headline: Raised money after the show, rebranded, then shut down in 2023.
outcome.story: Beulr got a burst of users and raised $675,000 from other investors after the episode. It tried to rebrand as an AI meeting-notes tool but closed in November 2023.
